centering: Exact reserved source centre; freeze metadata plan before pixels; no relocation, padding, resizing or model inference
uncertainty: Existing original, coordinate half-step plus 30s, and one-step plus 60s scenarios; 300m base plus 1m/s maximum native-row time separation. Heuristic search scenarios, not calibrated accuracy bounds.
incomplete_coverage: Inspect unchanged window but abstain from source-supported class assignment
first_pass: Both bands and all four quadrants; no source overlays, distance reconciliation, detector outputs or classifier scores before sealed first-pass annotations
annotator: Codex AI assistant; no independent SAR reviewer
optical_scope: Sentinel-2 L1C footprint at target within +/-3h; record pagination/failure; metadata alone cannot confirm object identity
corroboration: Repeated IIP publisher identities are correlated context; additional physical evidence must identify the same reflector before exploratory iceberg training admission
